patch_description: Replace Ising gates (XX, YY, ZZ) with controlled parametrized gates (CRX, CRY, CRZ) on key entangling links. Prior program 2 demonstrated that CRX/CRY gates boost combined score from 0.58→0.59 by improving expressivity. The current program sacrificed validation accuracy (0.97→0.91) and worst_group_margin (0.34→0.33) for minimal parameter count. By selectively upgrading to controlled gates on strategic links, we can recover expressivity while keeping parameter efficiency reasonable. CRZ on [4,5] adds one new parameter while providing richer entanglement structure for the central link.
